entries.description: Built: web, iOS, server. LoRaWAN hardware integration - for an AI-driven healthcare operations platform. Shipped enterprise apps serving live customer deployments within months of joining.
Build LLM data & userflow analysis engine for the UN to help officers and government stakeholders understand procurement workflows.
Modernize the UN procurement platform with Svelte and modern .NET, helping drive $175M in global impact across regions including Palestine and Ukraine.
Open-source desk darkroom for film negatives. Rust + Tauri + SvelteKit, physical Beer-Lambert inversion engine, integrated AI features (upscaling, dust removal, enhancement).
Open-source darkroom for color film negatives. Rust + Tauri + SvelteKit, physical Beer-Lambert inversion engine, integrated AI features (upscaling, dust removal, enhancement).
GeForce Experience Game Optimization and Performance / Automation / Deep Learning.
Developed and published the first Manchurian visual novel, leading development and design, earned Very Positive Steam rating for its avant-garde art and cultural originality.
Led development of a sex-education game reaching 30K DAU and 300K+ users and featured by CGTN.
Invited by instructor Sharon Zhao to give a lecture on Gamification Applications, covering entrepreneurial problem-solving methods and application-level technical concepts.
Built an open-source Svelte component library that auto-generates frontends from UiMetadataFramework, now used across multiple UN services.
A non-profit photography gallery featuring contemporary local artists alongside works from Renaissance to Shamanic traditions, open free to the public.
More club is a school club I started with my friends in High School; ran viral social media and made killer apps. It is the best club in my high school's history.
